blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: Many people dream of discovering everything Tanzania has to offer. Think of an epic Tanzania safari in search of Africa’s Big Five, a climb up Kilimanjaro or lazy days on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: you will find it all in Tanzania. The good news is that Your Tanzania Trip can put together a custom made itinerary that matches all your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: For inspiration, take a look at our most popular itineraries. After an exciting safari, most of our clients like to unwind for a few days on one of the most stunning beaches of Zanzibar. Does that sound good to you too?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: You can pick one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or have your journey tailored to you; either way, we are ready to help. Join us and get ready to discover Tanzania at your own pace, just the way you want it!

blocks.orig: When you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there waiting for you. He then drops you off at your hotel, where you can relax from your flight.
blocks.html: Our Your Tanzania Trip guide is waiting for you on arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport. He takes you to your hotel, where you can rest after your flight.

blocks.orig: Preparation for your climb: You meet your guide before the start of your climb, where he briefs you and offers advice on what to wear, what to pack, and other important tips to make your climb as comfortable as possible.
blocks.html: Getting ready for your climb: Before the climb begins you meet your guide, who gives you a briefing and advises you on clothing, packing and other useful tips so that your climb is as comfortable as it can be.

blocks.orig: In the early morning, your guide takes you from the hotel to Marangu Gate at 1,860 m. The initial part of the trek takes you through coffee and banana plantations, as well as untouched rainforest. Take this opportunity to admire the stunning views of lush vegetation and diverse wildlife along the way. After a seven-hour hike, you reach the Mandara Huts. In the afternoon, you can choose to visit the Maundi Crater, a volcanic crater near the huts, or simply relax and enjoy the beautiful surroundings. As this is your first day at this altitude, remember to drink plenty of water!
blocks.html: Early in the morning your guide drives you from the hotel to Marangu Gate at 1,860 m. The first stretch of the trek leads through coffee and banana plantations and unspoilt rainforest. Make the most of the lovely views of green vegetation and varied wildlife as you go. After seven hours of hiking you arrive at the Mandara Huts. In the afternoon you can visit the Maundi Crater, a volcanic crater close to the huts, or just rest and take in the beautiful surroundings. Since this is your first day at this altitude, be sure to drink lots of water!

blocks.orig: From Mandara Huts, the landscape slowly changes. You trek through picturesque landscapes, encounter unique flora and fauna, and immerse yourself in the majestic beauty of Mount Kilimanjaro. The higher you go, the less vegetation can be seen and the more it starts to look like a lunar landscape. The air also grows thinner with altitude. Experience the thrill of ascending higher, as you make your way to the cozy and comfortable Horombo Huts for dinner and overnight.
blocks.html: After the Mandara Huts the scenery gradually changes. You walk through picturesque terrain, see unique plants and animals, and take in the majestic beauty of Mount Kilimanjaro. The higher you climb, the sparser the vegetation becomes, until it begins to resemble a lunar landscape. The air gets thinner with altitude as well. Enjoy the excitement of climbing higher as you head for the cosy, comfortable Horombo Huts, where you have dinner and spend the night.

blocks.orig: Today is your additional acclimatization day. After breakfast, you go for a hike towards Kibo Huts and back. This gives your body ample time to get used to the altitude. After lunch, you have the opportunity to take some pictures of the Mawenzi Volcano, discover the area or just rest. Have a good night's sleep at the Horombo Huts again to be ready for the next day.
blocks.html: This is your extra day for acclimatisation. Following breakfast, you hike in the direction of Kibo Huts and return. That way your body has plenty of time to adjust to the altitude. In the afternoon, after lunch, you can photograph the Mawenzi Volcano, explore the surroundings or simply take a rest. Sleep well at the Horombo Huts once more so you are ready for tomorrow.

blocks.orig: Witness the dramatic landscape change as your hike leads through a kind of Alpine desert to a point between the two famous mountain peaks Kibo and Mawenzi. The landscape here is more open and bare and offers less shelter. The hike is challenging, but the thrill of approaching the majestic summit of Mount Kilimanjaro drives you to keep going. You arrive at Kibo Huts Camp for lunch. Don't forget to drink plenty of water and make sure you relax for the big day ahead!
blocks.html: See the scenery change dramatically as your hike takes you across a sort of Alpine desert to a spot between Kibo and Mawenzi, the two famous mountain peaks. Out here the terrain is more open and bare, with less shelter. It is a demanding hike, but the excitement of getting closer to the majestic summit of Mount Kilimanjaro keeps you going. You reach Kibo Huts Camp in time for lunch. Remember to drink lots of water, and be sure to rest before the big day that awaits you!

blocks.orig: At night you start your ascent to conquer the majestic Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa! The biggest challenge lies in the first part of this climb, until you reach Gilman's Point. From here, Uhuru Peak is not far away, and relatively easy to climb. Once at the summit, enjoy a beautiful sunrise, which is quite impressive at this height! You descend through the Kibo Huts Camp down to the Horombo Huts, where you have dinner and overnight. You are on your feet for about twelve hours today, so prepare for a challenging but rewarding day!
blocks.html: During the night you begin the climb to the majestic Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa! The hardest part is the first section, up to Gilman's Point. From there Uhuru Peak is close by and fairly easy to reach. At the summit you can watch a beautiful sunrise, which is quite something at this altitude! You then walk down via Kibo Huts Camp to the Horombo Huts for dinner and the night. Today you are on your feet for roughly twelve hours, so be ready for a tough but rewarding day!

blocks.orig: Your incredible journey comes to an end as you descend to Marangu Gate, the exit of Kilimanjaro National Park. This wonderful five to six-hour walk takes you through beautiful forests. Once at Marangu Gate, your guide drives you back to the hotel for a well-deserved rest and a celebration of your remarkable achievement. Unforgettable memories, breathtaking views, and a true sense of accomplishment await and will stay with you forever!
blocks.html: Your remarkable journey ends with the descent to Marangu Gate, where you leave Kilimanjaro National Park. This lovely walk of five to six hours leads through beautiful forests. At Marangu Gate your guide drives you back to the hotel, where you can have a well-earned rest and celebrate what you have achieved. You take home unforgettable memories, breathtaking views and a real sense of accomplishment that will stay with you forever!

blocks.orig: Sadly, this is the end of your holiday and the time to go home has arrived. Enjoy your last hours in Tanzania before our driver comes to pick you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still longing for more? It's also possible to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
blocks.html: Unfortunately your holiday is over, and it is time to travel home. Make the most of your final hours in Tanzania until our driver collects you and brings you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Not had enough yet? You can also extend your Kilimanjaro adventure with a few days of safari or a beach holiday!
